prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1173; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by the first name, if that's okay, but I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a traffic light on a main road, waiting for the light to turn green. Traffic was moving steadily in the other lanes.

Q: What happened next?

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My car was pushed forward into the intersection and my head snapped back, then forward.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?

A: I did, but I felt stiff almost right away. I didn't think much of it at first.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same evening. They told me I have a neck strain and gave me instructions to rest and take anti-inflammatory medication.

Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms right now?

A: Yes. My neck is sore, especially when I turn to check my blind spot while driving. I also get a dull headache by the end of the day.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I took two days off to rest, and I've been limiting how long I sit at my desk.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?

A: Only that I'm following my doctor's recommendations and I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. That concludes our statement.
